name: Mochizuki Kaori
source:
A bright and cheerful woman with some serious guts, and she doesn't shy away from anyone.

Her personality has made her a very popular hostess. She was involved in an incident a year ago and left town, but she returned recently to get married.

She and [url=/c15399]Ren[/url] get along well as siblings, and Ren thinks the world of his sister.

[From [url=http://mangagamerstaff.tumblr.com/post/111964766194/oh-youre-names-haru-im-kaori-and-this-is]MangaGamer[/url]]
